notes.title: [Patch Note] Monster Balancing
notes.content:
Hi,

Shortly after the launch today, our dev team did some adjustment on the monsters balance. Please update the game before playing the game.

We are happy to hear feedback from you! Feel free to send us an email at infernocs@yjmgames.com.

Thank you! :)
